definitions.explanation: The closed-fist hand shape in the game janken, which beats scissors (チョキ) and loses to paper (パー). Also refers to a clenched fist more generally.

examples.japanese: {最初|さいしょ}はグーを{出|だ}した。
グーはチョキに{勝|か}つ。
{手|て}をグーにして、{力|ちから}を{込|こ}めた。
examples.english: I made my hand into a fist and put strength into it.

notes:
One of the three hand shapes in じゃんけん (rock-paper-scissors), together with チョキ (scissors) and パー (paper). グー is a closed fist; it beats チョキ and loses to パー.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- グーを{出|だ}す: to throw rock
- {手|て}をグーにする: to clench the hand into a fist
- {最初|さいしょ}はグー: "rock first" (the standard call that starts a game)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- チョキ: scissors — the two-finger shape
- パー: paper — the open-hand shape
